caption: The drawing depicts a floor-length evening dress with a full, voluminous skirt in light pastel pink hues, with soft yellow and white highlights suggesting the sheen and folds of the fabric. The bodice is fitted and off-the-shoulder, with a straight neckline accented by a bow or knot at the center and gently ruched fabric panels extending to the short sleeves. The sleeves are decorated with two layers of ruffled, translucent fabric in matching pastel colors, adding volume and texture. The dress flares out dramatically from the waist with vertical lines indicating gathers or pleats. In the upper right corner, there is a smaller, less detailed line drawing of the dress from the back, showing the continued full skirt, off-the-shoulder cut, and ruffled sleeves. The background is a light, neutral tone and the signature "M. Concha" appears near the lower right.
title: Dress
